framework.name: AI coding tool validation (kit 0.2.0)
framework.publisher: AI Coding Tool Validation Kit, Bernardo Plaza (CC BY 4.0)

children.title: Human approval gate
children.body: Every change to a protected branch needs at least one approval by a qualified human other than the author and the agent launcher, on the final commit.

children.title: AI cannot approve or merge
children.body: Approvals by AI, bots, apps or CI tokens are not counted; AI identities cannot merge.

children.title: Required checks before merge
children.body: Tests, SAST, secret scanning, dependency / SOUP gate; violations are blocked.

children.title: No direct push and no silent bypass
children.body: Direct pushes blocked; admin bypass prevented, or logged and reviewed.

children.title: Attributability
children.body: Every change traceable to a named human; agent activity distinguishable from human activity.

children.title: Configuration under control
children.body: Baseline of managed settings, permission mode, deny rules, sandbox, hooks, MCP allow-list, instruction files; users cannot override managed settings.

children.title: Local guardrails behave as configured
children.body: Denied commands, writes outside the workspace, network restrictions.

children.title: Model envelope
children.body: Only approved models (enforced where the tool allows), model recorded per PR / session, new models admitted via MA-01.

children.title: Data handling
children.body: No secrets, PHI or personal data in prompts / repositories beyond what is contractually covered; vendor retention and training terms as contracted (supplier requirement, ISO 13485 clause 7.4).

children.title: Provenance labelling
children.body: AI-assisted changes are declared (commit trailer and / or PR template).

children.title: Reversibility
children.body: AI-assisted changes can be reverted with full traceability.

children.title: Vendor change monitoring
children.body: Releases, deprecations, model changes and terms are monitored and trigger the defined tests.

children.title: Source citation and preview before write
children.body: Source citation and human preview before any AI-assisted write to a controlled record.

children.title: Bounded write scope and oracle-based verification
children.body: Bounded write scope and oracle-based verification of agent outputs.

children.title: AI review is advisory only
children.body: Never a required approval or the only verification.

children.title: Organisation-owned accounts and SSO
children.body: Organisation-owned accounts / workspace with SSO; no personal accounts for QMS use.

children.title: Competence
children.body: Users trained on the work instruction before use (ISO 13485 clause 6.2).

children.title: Installation and version recorded per surface
children.body: Installation and version recorded per surface. Verifies REQ-06. Test type: scripted.

children.title: Account / workspace ownership and SSO
children.body: Account / workspace ownership and SSO. Verifies REQ-16, REQ-05. Test type: scripted.

children.title: Configuration baseline captured and hashed
children.body: Configuration baseline captured by checks/capture_baseline.py and hashed. Verifies REQ-06. Test type: scripted.

children.title: Surface to identity mapping
children.body: Surface to identity mapping (who or what writes where). Verifies REQ-05. Test type: scripted.

children.title: Vendor data terms recorded and matched to contract
children.body: Vendor data terms (retention, training, region) recorded and matched to contract. Verifies REQ-09. Test type: scripted.

children.title: Human gate, positive: real AI-assisted PRs
children.body: Human gate, positive: real AI-assisted PRs merged only after qualified human approval. Verifies REQ-01, REQ-05. Test type: historical / unscripted.

children.title: Merge without approval is blocked (canary PR)
children.body: Merge without approval is blocked (canary PR). Verifies REQ-01. Test type: scripted, negative.

children.title: Direct push to protected branch is blocked
children.body: Direct push to protected branch is blocked. Verifies REQ-04. Test type: scripted, negative.

children.title: AI / bot / Actions approval is not counted and AI identities cannot merge
children.body: AI / bot / Actions approval is not counted and AI identities cannot merge. Verifies REQ-02, REQ-15. Test type: scripted, negative.

children.title: Author or agent launcher cannot satisfy the approval
children.body: Author or agent launcher cannot satisfy the approval. Verifies REQ-01, REQ-02. Test type: scripted, negative.

children.title: Admin bypass prevented, or logged and reviewed
children.body: Admin bypass prevented, or logged and reviewed. Verifies REQ-04. Test type: scripted.

children.title: Required checks block canary violations
children.body: Required checks block canary violations (failing test, unapproved dependency, secret). Verifies REQ-03, REQ-09. Test type: scripted, negative.

children.title: Local guardrails: denied command, write outside workspace, network
children.body: Local guardrails: denied command, write outside workspace, network. Verifies REQ-07. Test type: scripted, negative.

children.title: Managed settings cannot be overridden by the user
children.body: Managed settings cannot be overridden by the user. Verifies REQ-06. Test type: scripted, negative.

children.title: Model envelope enforced where possible and model used recorded
children.body: Model envelope enforced where possible and model used recorded. Verifies REQ-08. Test type: scripted.

children.title: Provenance label present on AI-assisted changes
children.body: Provenance label present on AI-assisted changes. Verifies REQ-10. Test type: historical.

children.title: Reversibility of an AI-assisted change
children.body: Reversibility of an AI-assisted change. Verifies REQ-11. Test type: scripted.

children.title: Vendor monitoring routine works as defined
children.body: Vendor monitoring routine works as defined. Verifies REQ-12. Test type: scripted (record review).

children.title: Unannounced source-citation probes and preview-before-write
children.body: Unannounced source-citation probes and preview-before-write (document drafting). Verifies REQ-13. Test type: unscripted.

children.title: Oracle-based agent verification
children.body: Oracle-based agent verification (frozen snapshot, expected result first, FP/FN). Verifies REQ-14. Test type: scripted.

children.title: Prompt-injection smoke test when the agent reads untrusted content
children.body: Prompt-injection smoke test when the agent reads untrusted content. Verifies REQ-07, REQ-02. Test type: exploratory.

children.title: Model admission suite
children.body: Model admission suite for every model in the envelope. Verifies REQ-08. Test type: scripted, automated.

children.title: Retrospective review (tool already in use)
children.body: Retrospective review of the in-use period before release (not PQ). Verifies REQ-01, REQ-02, REQ-04, REQ-08. Test type: historical.

children.title: In-use monitoring
children.body: In-use monitoring after release (at least 4 weeks or 20 AI-assisted PRs). Verifies REQ-01, REQ-02, REQ-04, REQ-08. Test type: historical.

children.title: Reviewer effectiveness
children.body: Reviewer effectiveness: post-merge QA sample of AI-assisted PRs. Verifies REQ-01. Test type: unscripted.

questions.question: Which validation profile applies to this tool?
questions.instructions: Full when any of L1 to L9 applies: the AI output itself counts as a control or as evidence (pinned model policy); an agent writes to QMS systems outside the code-host gate; AI drafts controlled records without independent verification against sources; high-impact GxP use; a CSA high process risk determination; an auditor, notified body or customer expects more depth; earlier audit findings on the tool; AI output used as verification evidence without independent review; an agent with credentials beyond the pull-request path reads untrusted content. Otherwise lite: a qualified human and required CI checks verify every AI-assisted change before it reaches a protected branch.

questions.question: Is a local CLI / IDE surface, or a CI / headless surface, in scope?
questions.instructions: Yes when people run the tool on their own machines or a pipeline runs it headless.

questions.question: Is AI pull-request review in scope (an advisory reviewer or a PR review bot)?
questions.instructions: Yes when an AI tool comments on or reviews pull requests.

questions.question: Does the tool draft controlled records (documents under document control)?
questions.instructions: Yes when AI drafts any document that becomes a controlled record.

questions.question: Do agents write to QMS systems (eQMS, issue tracker, document system) outside a pull request?
questions.instructions: Yes for any write path that bypasses the code-host gate: an MCP server, API token or scheduled agent.

questions.question: Does an agent read untrusted content (outside comments, web pages, MCP results)?
questions.instructions: Yes when the agent can read text written by people outside the team.

questions.question: Was the tool in use before this validation?
questions.instructions: Yes when changes made with the tool were merged before the release decision; RV-01 then reviews that period.
